rows.en: Breeding EATERs…?
…A phone?
Hello, it's me…

Ah…

Atefarina?

Atefarina, you said!? Hey, [HERO4]! Are you all right!? Hello…

Damn… Don't tell me she's going to jump into the fire again? And Atefarina worries me…

I have to hurry! [HERO4]! Please be safe!
[HERO4]… You're safe?
Thank goodness… Thank goodness.
Fufufu… Oh dear, did I interrupt something?

…!?

Atefarina! You…!

Oh my…?

It seems that trip through the dimension distortion field really took it out of you, hm?
What!?

Now then… Playtime is over!

At last… our Space Fortress Naager has begun its landing approach to Earth!

What…

Hmph! That's exactly what we want! The TDF has deployed special units, all its forces combined, around Earth's sphere!

Getting through the atmosphere will be next to impossible, won't it?

Oh? That's odd.

According to Apfaron… the report said we won the head-on clash in space…

Did I hear wrong? Fufufu…

That doesn't mean you've won…

The TDF has a missile attack ready too!

Missiles?

Oh? Apfaron said something about watching fireworks go up from inside the ship…

Could that have been the missile attack? We thought it was a welcoming fireworks show.

…!?

The TDF's long-range missile attack failed too!?

Fufufu… It seems they tried rather hard, though?

Apparently the hull didn't get a single scratch.
Kuh…

It seems the difference in power is obvious, isn't it?

And… let me tell you this up front: that space fortress has no entrance!

In other words, it's an impregnable fortress that no one can even get into! Remember that well! Hahaha…
Wait! Atefarina!!
Don't worry! We won't lose! We can't afford to lose!
A week was nearly gone since the Space Fortress Naager had come to a halt exactly midway between Earth and the Moon…
The battle in space was now about to turn into a direct confrontation with the Naager itself!
At the evil king looking down upon the blue planet from high in the heavens, the arrow of resistance was at this very moment about to be loosed…
It's beautiful, huh?
You never thought you'd see a view like this, did you?

Geez, [HERO2]!

Hey… can you even hear me?
Hmph! I'm going home!

Yeah…

Huh? H-hey! Wait a second!
Well… you're ignoring me, [HERO2].

That's not it!

I was remembering… that day.
That day…?
It's gotten completely dark, huh?
Mr. Tachibana must be worried, I bet!

You're right…

[HERO4]… you'd better give him a call.
Okay…
Hey… I sense something strange.
You! Who are you?
So you're the Vol Textured Type?
What!? How do you know that…?
Fufufu… Because I'm the one who gave birth to you!
Gave birth to us?

I see…!

You're the one who attacked the Far East Base, the Battle Fleet Nation Naager's Atefarina the Battle Princess!?
Oh? How nice! You actually know who I am?
What's your goal? Why are you doing this!?

Goal? Let's see…

One of them… is to open a dimension distortion field here on Earth!
A dimension distortion field?

You lot might not be able to understand…

Just what the power of the Battle Fleet Nation Naager is? What a dimension distortion field is? I'll teach you plenty!

What!?

What are you going to do?
Fufufu… Hahaha…!
What kind of ship is that? It took all those missiles and wasn't damaged in the slightest…

Director Yamaoka!

In that case, let's fire the planet-destroying missile whose development was cancelled, Super Weapon R1, at the Naager!

Calm down!

It's too late! If we use R1 at this distance, Earth will suffer the same fate!
But at this rate…
For now, all we can do is wait for the enemy's next move! All we can do is wai…
The TDF's long-range missile attack had failed. But… Earth has heroes with glorious battle records!
They must protect humanity's home from every invasion! Believing in an end to a battle that no one knows when will ever end…
Defeat Valkyria!
Defeat Valkyria and all Gigants!
The fugitive mutant… still not captured?
But he can break himself down into atoms at will! Normally, you can't even see him.
When the mutant materializes, he gives off tremendous energy. If we detect that energy…

Capture the mutant and find out how he is able to break his own body down into atoms!

If we create Miraclers that can do the same, they'll be a great force…
As you command…
Doctor, I'll give as much blood as you need! Please save Go!
Quiet, please…
How is he?
At the moment, I can't say…

We can't let Go die!

He saved a child's life… no, even a puppy's life. And MAT needs him. We can't let him die!
We're doing everything we can.
…Go isn't gonna die!
Go…
Go, the Ryusei-go is finished. It can run anytime, it's ready anytime! Can you hear me, Go!
Suddenly appearing in a city overrun by pollution, the oil monster Takkong! A young man was gravely injured saving a boy and some animals from the kaiju…
A young man who loves children and every living thing, who would throw away his own life to save others: Hideki Go!
Now young Go's life is about to go out, like a candle flame flickering in the wind. Hang in there, Go! Don't die, Go!
…He has passed away.

uncertain: U05801: sentence restructured; the 'evil king' is the Naager's ruler.
U05833: line cut off as in the source ('All we can do is wai…').
U05851: 流星号 (Ken Sakata's car) kept as 'Ryusei-go'.
